text: D208387 review requested the old localization notes for the Archives and Inbox labels after the DTD-to-Fluent move. The accepted FTL keeps comments saying each name must match the default folder name. The controls carry .label and .accesskey attributes, while ordinary text such as the dialog title is a simple Fluent value. Current archive-options FTL still has those folder-name comments; later HTML preview markup changed the folder names to simple -label values. Choose the Fluent value shape for its target and preserve translator meaning.
